P.name: Cell Division
P.title: Template:Data Zac/Cell Division
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Cell Division|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Zac
|skill        = I
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate - Goo:}} {{cis|Zac}} abilities have a {{as|{{sti|health cost}}}}. Whenever '''Zac's''' abilities damage an enemy, he sheds a number of chunks on the ground that remain for a few seconds. '''Zac''' and enemy champions can collect the chunks; an enemy will destroy it, while '''Zac''' will {{tip|heal}} a portion of {{as|his '''maximum''' health}}.
|blurb2      = {{sbc|Innate - Cell Division:}} Periodically when '''Zac''' would die, he instead enters {{tip|resurrection}} for a period, splitting into four ''bloblets'' that can be attacked by enemies. '''Zac''' will {{tip|death|die}} once all ''bloblets'' are killed.
|icon         = false
|description  = {{sbc|Innate - The Secret Weapon:}} '''Zac''' gains increased percentage {{tip|size}} equal to {{as|{{fd|1.5}}% of his '''bonus''' health}}, capped at 35% increased size at {{as|{{fd|{{#expr:35/0.015 round 1}}{{recurring|3}}}} '''bonus''' health}}. '''Zac's''' size also reduces based on his {{as|'''missing''' health}}, down to 70% '''total''' size while at {{as|0% health}}.
|description2 = {{sbc|Innate - Goo:}} Whenever '''Zac''' hits enemies with an {{tip|ability}}, he sheds a number of chunks of himself to a nearby location, landing towards nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy {{tip|champions}} and lasting for 6 seconds.
* ''{{ai|Stretching Strikes|Zac}}'': 1 chunk for the initial hit, and 1 chunk if the second hits a different enemy
* ''{{ai|Unstable Matter|Zac}}'': 1 chunk if it hits at least one enemy
* ''{{ai|Elastic Slingshot|Zac}}'': 1 chunk for each enemy champion hit, with a minimum of 1 if it hits at least one enemy
* ''{{ai|Let's Bounce!|Zac}}'': 1 chunk for each bounce that hits at least one enemy
|description3 = Both '''Zac''' and enemy champions can interact with a chunk by being within 50 units of it: an enemy will destroy it, while '''Zac''' will consume it to {{tip|heal}} for {{as|{{pp|key=%|4 + (8-4)/17*(x-1) for 20}} of his '''maximum''' health}}.
|icon4        = Cell Division.png
|description4 = {{sbc|Innate - Cell Division:}} Periodically, upon taking {{tip|death|fatal damage}}, '''Zac''' enters {{tip|resurrection}} for {{pp|8 to 4 for 5|1;6;10;13;17}} seconds, instantly restoring {{as|50% of his '''maximum''' health}} and becoming {{tip|untargetable}} and {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} for the duration. '''Zac''' then splits into four uncontrollable [[File:Cell_Division.png|20px|link=Zac#Pets]] ''[[Zac#Pets|bloblets]]'' away from his location, though stopping at terrain. After {{fd|1.5}} seconds of the ''bloblets'' being {{tip|untargetable}}, they start moving toward '''Zac's''' location over the {{tt|remaining duration|Regardless of distance}}. Any damage the ''bloblets'' receive, excluding damage dealt in excess of each ''bloblet's'' {{as|'''total maximum''' health}}, is also echoed to '''Zac''' as {{sti|{{as|true damage}}}}. While in resurrection, '''Zac''' cannot take damage from sources other than the echoed damage from his ''bloblets''.
|description5 = After the duration, '''Zac''' is revived with {{as|{{tt|10 – 50%|Based on his bloblets' total remaining health. Reaches the maximum amount at full health on all bloblets}} '''maximum''' health}}. '''Zac''' will be {{tip|execute|executed}} once all bloblets are killed.
|description6 = ''See [[Zac#Pets|Pets]] for stats and details for bloblets.''
|range        = {{tip|cr|icononly=true}} {{tt|700|Maximum straight-line bloblet split range, estimated. Bloblets will not go over terrain if their pathfinding length exceeds this range.}}
|static       = 300
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Self
|damagetype   = 
|spelleffects = 
|spellshield  = 
|projectile   = 
|notes        = 
* The damage directed to '''Zac''' is {{tip|raw damage|internal raw damage}}.
* '''Zac's''' health when the ''bloblets'' are sent out is set to what it would be if all ''bloblets'' recombined, and is actively updated when the ''bloblets'' take damage.
* '''Zac's''' increased size does not consider his base stats.
* ''Cell Division's'' ''chunks'' spawn in two versions:
** {{sbc|Contestable:}} They will fall to the ground at a point which is roughly equidistant from '''Zac''' and the nearest {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy champion within 1000 range of him (dropping slightly in '''Zac's''' favor). The location at which they fall to the ground is influenced by the direction in which '''Zac''' is currently facing. Cannot be interacted with for the first {{fd|0.25}} seconds (except during {{ai|Let's Bounce!|Zac}}).
** {{sbc|Uncontestable:}} They will fall to the ground near '''Zac''' and can be picked up immediately (version used by default).
* '''Zac's''' {{tip|untargetability}} upon triggering ''Cell Division'' does not {{tip|homing projectile destruction|destroy}} in-flight {{tip|projectiles}}.
* {{ai|Chronoshift|Zilean}} and {{ii|Guardian Angel}} will take priority over ''Cell Division''.
* {{ii|Spirit Visage}} and {{sti|Heal Power|link=Heal and shield power}} increases the healing of both ''chunks'' and ''bloblets''.
* {{cai|Realm Warp|Ryze}} is able to individually teleport '''Zac''' or his ''bloblets'' during ''Cell Division''.
** If '''Zac''' is transported to a new location before the ''bloblets'' landed, they will travel to form at his new position, adjusting their speed accordingly. If ''Cell Division's'' duration permits during this time, '''Zac''' will be revived even if the ''bloblets'' fail to physically recombine.
* ''Cell Division's'' ''bloblets'' can be targeted by {{si|Teleport}} and {{cai|Force of Will|Syndra}}.
** Other ''bloblets'' are not interrupted by the conditions above and will continue to recombine instinctively.
* If '''Zac's''' health is higher than it is supposed to be when the ''bloblets'' converge on him, his health will be set to the correct value.
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Zac''' is in resurrection:
{{ct|move=false|cast=false|attack=false|items=false|consume=false|spells=false|interrupts=death}}
}}
